critical_code_review_comments: RichTextEditor.tsx now uncontrolled — innerHTML written only on mount and on htmlMode toggle. Parent onChange no longer feeds back into value, so caret/selection are preserved. Good.
Colour palette saves Range on mousedown (preventDefault stops focus loss) and restores it before execCommand('foreColor') — matches recommended pattern for contentEditable.
CourseEditPage.tsx keys RichTextEditor per slide so switching slides remounts and reloads content — clean approach.
Note: document.execCommand is technically deprecated but still works in all evergreen browsers; long-term consider Tiptap/ProseMirror but current implementation is production-adequate.
